mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Team at Zalopay. In this role, you will lead end-to-end ML solutions, optimize data pipelines, and apply modern AI/ML methodologies to solve core business problems.
What You’ll Do
Design and engineer robust features from high-dimensional data to maximize model predictive power.
Develop, deploy, and monitor high-scale predictive scoring and deep learning representation models across downstream systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Platform Engineers,...) to optimize ML pipelines for low latency, automate drift monitoring, and integrate reusable features into the centralized feature store.
Evaluate and adopt modern AI/ML techniques and tooling to solve practical business challenges.
Foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement through technical mentorship and engineering standards.
yeu_cau:
Master’s/PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or equivalent practical experience.
4 - 8+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning solutions on large-scale production data.
Strong foundation in ML System Design, statistics, and core machine learning principles (familiarity with NLP is a plus).
Proficient in Python, distributed computing, large-scale data processing engines, advanced SQL and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow).
Experience in Credit Scoring / Credit Risk modeling, especially in lending, fintech, banking, or financial services.
Self-directed and adaptable, with a strong ability to navigate complex architectures, and drive projects end-to-end.
